modern_reference.label: Modern reference
modern_reference.description: Inherited central mixed terrestrial-marine budget; 185/290 land production.
modern_reference.status: Existing reference configuration; no biological parameters changed

numerical_validation.scope: 180 unreduced comparisons: 152 mean-isoflux states and 14 at each one-sigma source-isoflux endpoint; sampled discrepancies, not continuous bounds

marine_endmember.label: Marine biosphere end member
marine_endmember.description: Marine-only light-active reference following the Blunier (2012) surface uptake prose (0.514) and interior reference (0.516), supported by original Angert/Helman process data; fixed reference seawater/20C and no geological age assigned.
marine_endmember.source_locations: Blunier (2012) p.1514 marine prose, Tables2-3 and Eq.9; Angert (2003) Eqs.5-6 and paragraph42; Helman (2005) TableII and photorespiratory 2:1 uptake discussion

parameter_authority.respiration_and_equilibrium: Published model assumptions and fractionation formula, not fitted here
parameter_authority.zero_source_fractionation: Published baseline; the effective mixed-layer respiratory fractionation already incorporates photosynthetic recycling
parameter_authority.pure_marine: User-authorized limiting scenario, not a measured historical land fraction
parameter_authority.20_c_and_reference_seawater: Explicit fixed reference choices, not reconstructed Paleozoic conditions
parameter_authority.accessibility: Inherited full atmospheric accessibility; not a new gas-transfer or ocean-ventilation model

marine_endmember.source_qualification: Source-reconstructed light-active mixture supports the prose surface exponent 0.514, with interior 0.516. Fractions/taxonomy are model assumptions; not a universal marine law or author-confirmed erratum.
marine_endmember.gpp_definition: Inherited OXYTIB oxygen-equivalent gross turnover: major-O2 production = GPP(PgC/yr)*1e15/12.0107, with full accessibility. No new carbon-to-oxygen or photorespiration multiplier.
marine_endmember.status: Fixed optional configuration; implementation and validation scope are recorded in model_data/publication_model_contract_v1.json
